lines.zh: 我的根还短，走起来一颠一颠。
lines.en: My roots are still short, so I bob with every step.

lines.zh: 从松果里长出的腿，踩在松针上。
lines.en: These legs grown from a pinecone step on fallen needles.

lines.zh: 我跟着你的脚印，慢慢挪。
lines.en: I follow your footprints and shuffle along.

lines.zh: 树干细细的，风一吹我就歪。
lines.en: My trunk is thin, and one gust tips me sideways.

lines.zh: 我试着迈大步，结果摔了个跟头。
lines.en: I try a big stride and end up tumbling over.

lines.zh: 土松的地方，我的根扎得深些。
lines.en: Where the soil is loose, I sink my roots deeper.

lines.zh: 我绕着母树走，不敢走太远。
lines.en: I circle the mother tree, not daring to go far.

lines.zh: 枝条还软，走路时晃得厉害。
lines.en: My branches are still soft and swing wildly as I walk.

lines.zh: 我踩到自己的根，差点绊倒。
lines.en: I step on my own root and nearly trip.

lines.zh: 林间的光斑跟着我移动。
lines.en: Patches of forest light travel along with me.

lines.zh: 我走得慢，但方向很确定。
lines.en: I walk slowly, but my direction is certain.

lines.zh: 松果壳还挂在肩上，走一步响一下。
lines.en: The pinecone husk still hangs on my shoulder, clicking each step.

lines.zh: 我站着晒太阳，树皮暖起来。
lines.en: I stand in the sun until my bark grows warm.

lines.zh: 我的枝上只有三片叶子，我数过。
lines.en: I have only three leaves on my branches; I counted.

lines.zh: 风来时我学着母树摇。
lines.en: When the wind comes, I sway the way the mother tree does.

lines.zh: 我把根尖探进土里，试试湿度。
lines.en: I probe a root tip into the soil to test the dampness.

lines.zh: 有只蚂蚁爬上我的手臂，我等着它走。
lines.en: An ant climbs my arm, and I wait for it to pass.

lines.zh: 我记得自己是从一枚松果里裂开的。
lines.en: I remember splitting open from a single pinecone.

lines.zh: 我偷偷比了比母树的高度，差得远。
lines.en: I quietly compare heights with the mother tree; not close.

lines.zh: 松脂从我的节里渗出来，黏黏的。
lines.en: Resin seeps from my joints, sticky and slow.

lines.zh: 我听见远处有斧头声，缩了缩枝。
lines.en: I hear an axe far off and pull my branches in.

lines.zh: 我在原地转圈，找更亮的地方。
lines.en: I turn in place, hunting for a brighter spot.

lines.zh: 我的影子很小，像一株灌木。
lines.en: My shadow is small, like that of a shrub.

lines.zh: 我打了个哈欠，叶子抖了抖。
lines.en: I yawn, and my leaves tremble.

lines.zh: 泥土里有虫在动，我低头看。
lines.en: Something moves in the dirt, and I look down.

lines.zh: 我学不会不动，总想晃两下。
lines.en: I cannot learn to stay still and always sway a little.

lines.zh: 我把根往深处送了一点。
lines.en: I push my roots a little deeper.

lines.zh: 树影移过来了，光换了地方。
lines.en: The shade came over; the light moved.

lines.zh: 我数着松针落下来的次数。
lines.en: I count the pine needles falling.

lines.zh: 有只甲虫在我脚边打转。
lines.en: A beetle circles my roots.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我才有你膝盖高。
lines.en: You crouch, and I am only as tall as your knee.

lines.zh: 你手里有松果吗？我盯着看。
lines.en: Do you have a pinecone? I keep staring at your hands.

lines.zh: 我仰头看你，脖子是树干做的。
lines.en: I look up at you with a neck made of trunk.

lines.zh: 你伸手，我缩了缩，又凑近。
lines.en: You reach out; I flinch, then lean closer.

lines.zh: 你给我一棵苗，我就跟你走。
lines.en: Give me one sapling, and I will follow you.

lines.zh: 你的影子罩住我，我很安心。
lines.en: Your shadow covers me, and I feel safe.

lines.zh: 我认得你的味道，是土和汗。
lines.en: I know your smell; it is soil and sweat.

lines.zh: 你说话时，我的叶子跟着颤。
lines.en: When you speak, my leaves tremble along.

lines.zh: 你走一步，我要走三步才跟上。
lines.en: For each step you take, I need three to keep up.

lines.zh: 我抬头太久，脖子酸了。
lines.en: I have looked up too long and my neck aches.

lines.zh: 你摸摸我的树冠，我站得笔直。
lines.en: You pat my crown, and I stand perfectly straight.

lines.zh: 我不确定你是敌人还是种树的人。
lines.en: I cannot tell if you are a foe or a tree planter.

lines.zh: 你蹲着不动，我就慢慢靠过去。
lines.en: If you stay crouched and still, I will edge closer.

lines.zh: 你的靴子比我的整棵树还宽。
lines.en: Your boot is wider than my entire little tree.

lines.zh: 你手里没有斧头，我就放心了。
lines.en: No axe in your hand, so I relax.

lines.zh: 你说话，我的叶子一片片抬起。
lines.en: As you speak, my leaves lift one by one.

lines.zh: 我的枝被折了，疼得直晃。
lines.en: A branch of mine is snapped, and I sway with pain.

lines.zh: 树皮破了一小块，我低头看。
lines.en: A patch of bark is torn, and I look down at it.

lines.zh: 我退到母树背后，根都在抖。
lines.en: I retreat behind the mother tree, my roots trembling.

lines.zh: 这一下让我矮了半截。
lines.en: That blow left me half a body shorter.

lines.zh: 我抱住自己的树干，慢慢蹲下。
lines.en: I hug my own trunk and crouch down slowly.

lines.zh: 伤口渗出一点松脂，我舔了舔。
lines.en: A little resin seeps from the wound; I lick it.

lines.zh: 我的叶子掉了两片，我捡起来。
lines.en: Two of my leaves fall, and I pick them up.

lines.zh: 我疼得说不出话，只有枝在响。
lines.en: Pain leaves me wordless; only my branches creak.

lines.zh: 我学着母树站定，可腿在软。
lines.en: I try to stand firm like the mother tree, but my legs soften.

lines.zh: 这点伤对我太大了，我才十点血。
lines.en: That wound is too much for me; I only have ten health.

lines.zh: 你摊开手，掌心里有一枚松果。
lines.en: You open your hand, and a pinecone lies in the palm.

lines.zh: 那点泥土的湿气让我挪不动脚。
lines.en: That damp smell of earth pins my feet in place.

lines.zh: 你把幼苗递过来，我的根先伸了。
lines.en: You offer a seedling and my roots reach out first.

lines.zh: 我闻到同类的味道，想靠近。
lines.en: I smell one of my own kind and want to come closer.

lines.zh: 你晃了晃手里的枝，我跟着晃。
lines.en: You wiggle the branch in your hand, and I wiggle too.

lines.zh: 只要一棵苗，我就认你。
lines.en: One sapling is all it takes for me to accept you.

lines.zh: 阳光落在你手上，我以为那是食物。
lines.en: Sunlight falls on your hand, and I mistake it for food.

lines.zh: 我伸出枝，够你指间的水珠。
lines.en: I reach a branch for the water droplets between your fingers.

lines.zh: 你退开，我又跟上去两步。
lines.en: You step back, and I follow two steps more.

lines.zh: 我的根已经朝你那边长了。
lines.en: My roots have already started growing in your direction.

lines.zh: 你碰到我的枝，叶子掉了一片。
lines.en: You brush my branch and a leaf comes off.

lines.zh: 我撞到你小腿，自己先弹开。
lines.en: I bump your shin and bounce away first.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我晃了好久。
lines.en: We knock together, and I wobble for a long time.

lines.zh: 你踩到我的根，我抽了一下。
lines.en: You step on my root and I jerk it free.

lines.zh: 我从你腿边挤过去，树皮蹭着你。
lines.en: I squeeze past your leg, bark scraping against you.

lines.zh: 我撞上母树的干，坐倒在地。
lines.en: I hit the mother tree's trunk and sit down hard.

lines.zh: 你推我一把，我倒退着走了三步。
lines.en: You push once, and I stagger back three steps.

lines.zh: 松针被我们踩得簌簌响。
lines.en: The pine needles rustle under both our feet.

lines.zh: 我挂住你的裤脚，被拖着走了半米。
lines.en: I snag your trouser cuff and get dragged half a meter.

lines.zh: 我们错身时，我的枝勾住你的腰带。
lines.en: As we pass, my branch hooks onto your belt.

lines.zh: 另一株小树人站在苗圃那头。
lines.en: Another little tree-person stands across the seedling bed.

lines.zh: 我把捡来的松果推给她。
lines.en: I push the pinecone I found toward her.

lines.zh: 我们的根在土里碰了一下。
lines.en: Our roots touch once beneath the soil.

lines.zh: 她的叶子比我多两片，我数过。
lines.en: She has two more leaves than I do; I counted.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，谁也不敢先动。
lines.en: We stand side by side, neither daring to move first.

lines.zh: 风把我们吹向同一个方向。
lines.en: The wind bends us both the same way.

lines.zh: 我学她的样子，把枝伸开。
lines.en: I copy her and spread my branches wide.

lines.zh: 她的树皮是浅的，我的是深的。
lines.en: Her bark is pale, and mine is dark.

lines.zh: 我们中间冒出一株新芽。
lines.en: A new shoot pushes up between us.

lines.zh: 等它长大，这片林子就有三个了。
lines.en: When it grows, there will be three of us in this wood.

lines.zh: 我捡起一枚松果，抱在怀里。
lines.en: I pick up a pinecone and hug it to my chest.

lines.zh: 落下的松针我一根根收好。
lines.en: I collect the fallen pine needles one by one.

lines.zh: 那块小石子挡路，我搬到一边。
lines.en: A small stone blocks the way, so I carry it aside.

lines.zh: 我把掉下的叶子放回枝上，没成功。
lines.en: I try putting a fallen leaf back on my branch, and fail.

lines.zh: 你掉的树苗，我替你捡起来了。
lines.en: You dropped a sapling; I have picked it up for you.

lines.zh: 我拾起断枝，插进湿土里。
lines.en: I pick up a broken branch and stick it in damp soil.

lines.zh: 地上一粒种子，我含了很久。
lines.en: There is a seed on the ground, and I hold it a long while.

lines.zh: 我把松果藏在根下，怕被拿走。
lines.en: I hide my pinecone under my roots, afraid it will be taken.

lines.zh: 捡来的东西我都堆在脚边。
lines.en: Everything I find gets piled at my feet.

lines.zh: 那枚空壳，我留着当帽子。
lines.en: That empty husk, I keep it as a hat.

lines.zh: 有东西在啃我的根，我低头看。
lines.en: Something is nibbling my root, and I look down.

lines.zh: 一只兔子窜过，我转头追它的影子。
lines.en: A rabbit darts past, and I turn after its shadow.

lines.zh: 谁踩坏了我的苗圃？我站直了。
lines.en: Who trampled my seedling bed? I stand up straight.

lines.zh: 我看见草丛里一双眼睛。
lines.en: I see a pair of eyes inside the grass.

lines.zh: 那东西靠得太近，我抬起枝。
lines.en: That thing is too close, so I raise a branch.

lines.zh: 我听见母树的枝在响，跟着警戒。
lines.en: I hear the mother tree's branches rattle and go on guard.

lines.zh: 它碰了我藏松果的地方。
lines.en: It touched the spot where I hid my pinecone.

lines.zh: 我把它框在视线里，慢慢转身。
lines.en: I frame it in my sight and turn slowly.

lines.zh: 它不大，但我不打算让路。
lines.en: It is not big, but I do not plan to step aside.

lines.zh: 我的根已经朝它那边偏了。
lines.en: My roots have already angled toward it.

lines.zh: 我压低枝条，学母树的样子。
lines.en: I lower my branches, copying the mother tree.

lines.zh: 它绕圈，我就跟着转，转得头晕。
lines.en: It circles, I turn with it, until my head spins.

lines.zh: 我守住苗圃的边，不让它进。
lines.en: I guard the seedling bed's edge and let it go no further.

lines.zh: 它退，我就上前一步。
lines.en: It retreats, and I take one step forward.

lines.zh: 我的叶子竖起来，尽量显得大。
lines.en: My leaves stand up to make me look bigger.

lines.zh: 我们隔着两丛草互相看。
lines.en: We watch each other across two clumps of grass.

lines.zh: 我憋着不动，根却在抖。
lines.en: I hold myself still, though my roots are shaking.

lines.zh: 它一动，我的枝就指过去。
lines.en: The moment it moves, my branch points at it.

lines.zh: 我等着它先靠近，再决定。
lines.en: I wait for it to come closer before deciding.

lines.zh: 我把它逼到母树的阴影里。
lines.en: I crowd it into the mother tree's shadow.

lines.zh: 我用枝抽它，力气不大但很准。
lines.en: I whip it with a branch, not hard but accurately.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，两个都摔在松针上。
lines.en: I charge, and we both land in the pine needles.

lines.zh: 我一脚踩下，踩空了半寸。
lines.en: I stamp a foot down and miss by half an inch.

lines.zh: 枝梢扫过它的背，它跳开了。
lines.en: My branch tip brushes its back and it leaps away.

lines.zh: 我抱着它往旁边推，推不动。
lines.en: I wrap around it and shove sideways, but it will not budge.

lines.zh: 我用树冠压它，它从缝里钻出。
lines.en: I press my crown down on it; it slips out through a gap.

lines.zh: 这一下我用了全身的劲，也只够它退一步。
lines.en: That took all my strength, and it only bought one step.

lines.zh: 我咬住它的尾巴，被甩了个跟头。
lines.en: I bite its tail and get thrown head over heels.

lines.zh: 我伸根绊它，它踉跄了一下。
lines.en: I stretch a root to trip it, and it stumbles.

lines.zh: 打完我自己也喘，树干一起一伏。
lines.en: Afterward I am panting, my trunk rising and falling.

lines.zh: 有人把远古松果埋进土里，我裂开了。
lines.en: Someone buried an ancient pinecone, and I split it open.

lines.zh: 我从壳缝里钻出来，先看见光。
lines.en: I push out through the husk seam and see light first.

lines.zh: 根一落地，我就知道该往哪长。
lines.en: The moment my root lands, I know which way to grow.

lines.zh: 土很松，我一使劲就站起来了。
lines.en: The soil is loose, and one push gets me upright.

lines.zh: 我的第一片叶子，是朝着母树的方向。
lines.en: My first leaf points toward the mother tree.

lines.zh: 我抖掉壳屑，试着走第一步。
lines.en: I shake off the husk bits and try a first step.

lines.zh: 这片苗圃被翻过，土是新的。
lines.en: This bed has been turned over; the soil is new.

lines.zh: 我出生时很小，比松果大不了多少。
lines.en: I was born tiny, not much bigger than a pinecone.

lines.zh: 我把根扎下去，又拔起来，想走。
lines.en: I sink my roots, then pull them up, wanting to walk.

lines.zh: 风把我吹歪，我自己站直了。
lines.en: The wind tips me over, and I straighten up myself.

lines.zh: 我听见母树在远处响，像在叫我。
lines.en: I hear the mother tree sound far off, as if calling me.

lines.zh: 我出生那天，林子里下了点雨。
lines.en: On the day I was born, a little rain fell in the wood.

lines.zh: 火苗窜上我的枝，我拼命往土里缩。
lines.en: Flames climb my branch and I shrink desperately toward the soil.

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下去，松果壳摔碎了。
lines.en: I tumble down the slope and my pinecone husk shatters.

lines.zh: 水淹到我的树冠，叶子全贴在干上。
lines.en: Water reaches my crown, and every leaf clings to my trunk.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀进灌木，枝折了一半。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the bushes and half my branches break.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我的枝间，钉在后头的树上。
lines.en: An arrow passes between my branches and sticks in a tree behind.

lines.zh: 一股凉气钻进树皮，我的根缩成一团。
lines.en: A cold draft enters my bark and my roots curl into a ball.

lines.zh: 土干得裂开，我的叶子开始发黄。
lines.en: The soil cracks dry, and my leaves begin to yellow.

lines.zh: 雷声在头顶炸开，我整株都在抖。
lines.en: Thunder bursts overhead and my whole body shakes.

lines.zh: 我掉进没有土的地方，根须乱抓。
lines.en: I fall where there is no soil, and my roots grab at nothing.
